trap-negation-contrast.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) findings, three of them material. (1) MISSING CONVENTION LABEL - directive violation. Every c_k value here (c_3 = J_Hopf(q=1) = -2, the c_2 = b^2 origin, the c_4 = b^2 + 1/2 entry, the c_5/c_6 breakdown) is CONVENTION-C-frame, and the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 makes convention D canonical and requires every c_k conclusion to be treated as C-conditional until the ladder is re-derived (bean qou-cds1). This block carries no such scoping. (2) NON-SEQUITUR in the parity rule: 'Even k stays within the Kashiwara block, AS THE HECKE QUADRATIC REDUCES sigma_i^k TO A POLYNOMIAL WITHIN H_n(q), generating no link invariant.' The Hecke quadratic reduces sigma^k to a linear polynomial in sigma for EVERY k >= 2, odd or even, so the stated cause does not distinguish the two cases it is offered to distinguish. The companion clause 'Odd k produces an even crossing number upon closure' is also unexplained and, read literally on sigma_1^k, backwards (sigma_1^k closes to a k-crossing (2,k) torus link). (3) c_5, c_6 DO NOT EXIST in the canonical producer. AGENTS.md records, with sorry-free Lean (QOU.QBeta.greedy_rung_exact / greedy_later_rungs_vanish), that qbeta_ck_cache.py extracts ONE rung by inverting the target, after which the next-rung residual is exactly zero and c_4 ... c_7 are NEVER COMPUTED. A claim that 'the alternating pattern breaks down at c_5, c_6' therefore describes quantities the canonical pipeline does not produce; the block should say where those values come from. (4) NAME: 'a Groebner-Buchberger filtration' - the corpus's non-commutative construction is Groebner-SHIRSHOV throughout (Buchberger's algorithm is the commutative one); this looks like a wrong expansion of the .ts tag 'GB-filtration'.
